s.how: Soften an onion and 2 garlic cloves with 1 tsp cumin. Add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, 150g red lentils and 800ml water and simmer 25 minutes, then blend smooth. Serve in mugs with grilled cheese fingers made from 4 slices bread and 100g cheddar.
Mix 400g pork mince with 1 grated carrot, 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 egg and 1 tbsp soy. Roll thin logs in 20 spring roll wrappers and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

m.how: Roll 600g beef mince with breadcrumbs, egg and parmesan into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes with garlic. Toss with 500g spaghetti. Split a baguette, spread with garlic butter and bake 12 minutes.

w.note: the coffee shop where MJ works at the end
w.how: Mix 350g flour, 7g yeast, 40g butter, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 180ml warm water and rest an hour. Cut rounds, prove 30 minutes and fry at 175C until golden. Pipe in 300ml thick custard and roll in 100g caster sugar.

d.note: Peter buying a coffee from MJ
d.how: Brew 4 strong espressos with 72g ground coffee. Steam 600ml milk until silky with fine bubbles. Pour over the coffee in four cups. Drink it while the world forgets who you are.
